"""Profile cards shown beside articles and reviews."""


def build_author_card(author):
    name = author["name"].strip().title()
    handle = "@" + author["handle"].lstrip("@").lower()
    bio = (author.get("bio") or "").strip()
    if len(bio) > 40:
        bio = bio[:37] + "..."
    links = sorted(set(author.get("links", [])))
    return {"title": name, "subtitle": handle, "text": bio, "links": links, "kind": "author"}


def build_reviewer_card(reviewer):
    handle = "@" + reviewer["handle"].lstrip("@").lower()
    name = reviewer["name"].strip().title()
    bio = (reviewer.get("bio") or "").strip()
    if len(bio) > 40:
        bio = bio[:37] + "..."
    links = sorted(set(reviewer.get("links", [])))
    return {"title": name, "subtitle": handle, "text": bio, "links": links, "kind": "reviewer"}
